[[Jar Jar Binks]]... What you say !! Everyone hates him, everyone loves him. Will he show up in yousa Light Side deck? Sure, whysa not? The clumsy Gungan can potentially fumble his way into any place, no matter how secure the location may be. He can trip his way into the [[Endor: Bunker]] even if [[Ephant Mon]] is guarding the place. He can waltz right into the Emperor's [[Death Star II: Throne Room]] -- followed by his Enhanced friends with permanent weapons to dispatch the Emperor.

Also, Jar Jar's game text can be handy in battle. Just like the movie, he can put someone out of commission. Upset and missing Jar Jar after his latest catastrophe? No problem. Nothing a [[Bacta Tank]] or [[Brisky Morning Munchen]] can't fix.
|combos=* [[Jar Jar Binks]] + [[Brisky Morning Munchen]]<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Jar%20Jar%20Binks</ref>
